sentences.text: Che-Chia Wei, known as C.C. Wei, born in Nantou County, Taiwan, in 1953, holds bachelor's and master's degrees in electrical engineering from National Chiao Tung University and a doctorate in electrical engineering from Yale University.

Before joining TSMC in 1998, he was Senior Vice President of Technology at Chartered Semiconductor Manufacturing in Singapore and Senior Manager for Logic and SRAM technology development at STMicroelectronics in Texas, following earlier research work at Texas Instruments.
